baa_10y_spread.proxy_note: Moody's Baa corporate bond yield minus the 10Y Treasury -- a long-run investment-grade credit-risk-premium PROXY, not the literal ICE BofA IG OAS series this system quotes daily. Real history back to 1986. Useful for direction and episode timing (did credit broadly tighten/widen, and when); its magnitude runs tighter than IG OAS and far tighter than HY OAS, so never quote its level as if it were either.
